what_happened.line: The Planning Board discussed how to write a non-medical marijuana bylaw and leaned toward a public workshop in June and a draft in early September, for a November Town Meeting.
The board agreed to reword the auto sales use definition, striking boats and recreational vehicles, and to type it up as an amendment to offer at Town Meeting.
The planning director explained that a host community agreement can collect a share of gross sales for up to five years, negotiated by the Board of Selectmen.
Members were asked to send the planning director questions for a marijuana survey, and guidance documents and sample bylaws are to be posted on the town site.
A permitting guidebook is being produced through the DLTA program at no cost to the town. No formal votes were recorded in the captions.

why_it_matters: A marijuana bylaw would set where retail can operate and how much the town can collect to offset related costs, and residents would be asked to vote on it at a Town Meeting.
The auto sales wording decides which vehicle businesses the zoning definition covers, and it is expected to come to the floor of Town Meeting as an amendment.
watch_next: A public workshop on the marijuana bylaw, which the board favored for June, and a draft in early September.
The typed auto sales definition amendment for Town Meeting.
